title: Normalized Lebesgue points of a locally integrable function on a set of locally finite Hᵏ-measure
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, Hᵏ := μHE[k] on ℝ^P = Eucl P, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, M ⊆ U Hᵏ-null-measurable with Hᵏ(M ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, and f : ℝ^P → ℝ Hᵏ-integrable on M ∩ K for every compact K ⊆ U. Then for Hᵏ⌞M-almost every x and every R > 0, r^{−k}·∫⁻_{M ∩ B̄_{Rr}(x)} |f(y) − f(x)| dHᵏ(y) → 0 as r ↓ 0 (r^{−k} is written ENNReal.ofReal((r^k)⁻¹), |·| is the extended norm ‖·‖ₑ, B̄_ρ(x) = closedBall x ρ).
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (f : Eucl P → ℝ), IsOpen U → M ⊆ U → NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)) (M ∩ K) < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IntegrableOn f (M ∩ K) (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P))) → ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal ((r ^ k)⁻¹) * ∫⁻ y in M ∩ closedBall x (R * r), ‖f y - f x‖ₑ ∂(μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
